plain_text:
Jack Moyles appears in 339 recordings across 22 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1943 to 1960. The credits here include performer, commercial spokesman, and writer.

In this archive, you will hear Jack Moyles most often in Rocky Jordan, Wild Bill Hickok, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, The Line Up, The Whistler, Fibber McGee and Molly, Gunsmoke, and Fort Laramie.

Characters credited here include Rocky Jordan, Sgt. Pete Karger, and Major Daggett.
